websites.title: Building AI Confidence in the Gaeltacht Workplace
websites.full_title: AI literacy and workplace training programme delivered by Munster Technological University for Údarás na Gaeltachta
websites.description: Course website for an AI literacy and workplace training programme developed for Irish speakers and business owners in the Gaeltacht, delivered through the medium of Irish. It covers an introduction to AI, generative AI and large language models, practical applications in everyday work, AI safety and responsible use, AI literacy and the EU AI Act, and the role of AI in supporting the Irish language.
